description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusAPI class, which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing Employment Status entities in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations such as getting, creating, updating, deleting, and listing employment statuses, along with validation rules and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD endpoints for EmploymentStatus entities, including get, list, create, update, and delete operations with validation and OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmploymentStatusService instance used to interact with employment status data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single EmploymentStatus entity by its ID, returning a resource result for API response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all employment statuses, applying filters, sorting, and pagination as specified in request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing employment statuses, including filters and sorting parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new EmploymentStatus entity based on request data and returns the created resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new employment status, primarily validating the 'name' field.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing EmploymentStatus entity identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an employment status, including ensuring unique names.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Helper method returning validation rules for the 'name' parameter, including uniqueness checks.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Populates and saves an EmploymentStatus entity based on request data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes employment statuses specified by IDs in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, mainly verifying presence of IDs.
